1.web: Why do you boast of mischief, mighty man? God’s loving kindness endures continually.
1.asv: Why boastest thou thyself in mischief, O mighty man? The lovingkindness of God endureth continually.

2.web: Your tongue plots destruction, like a sharp razor, working deceitfully.
2.asv: Thy tongue deviseth very wickedness, Like a sharp razor, working deceitfully.

3.web: You love evil more than good, lying rather than speaking the truth. Selah.
3.asv: Thou lovest evil more than good, And lying rather than to speak righteousness. [Selah

4.web: You love all devouring words, you deceitful tongue.
4.asv: Thou lovest all devouring words, O thou deceitful tongue.

5.web: God will likewise destroy you forever. He will take you up, and pluck you out of your tent, and root you out of the land of the living. Selah.
5.asv: God will likewise destroy thee for ever; He will take thee up, and pluck thee out of thy tent, And root thee out of the land of the living. [Selah

6.web: The righteous also will see it, and fear, and laugh at him, saying,
6.asv: The righteous also shall see it, and fear, And shall laugh at him, saying,

7.web: “Behold, this is the man who didn’t make God his strength, but trusted in the abundance of his riches, and strengthened himself in his wickedness.”
7.asv: Lo, this is the man that made not God his strength, But trusted in the abundance of his riches, And strengthened himself in his wickedness.

8.web: But as for me, I am like a green olive tree in God’s house. I trust in God’s loving kindness forever and ever.
8.asv: But as for me, I am like a green olive-tree in the house of God: I trust in the lovingkindness of God for ever and ever.

9.web: I will give you thanks forever, because you have done it. I will hope in your name, for it is good, in the presence of your saints.
9.asv: I will give thee thanks for ever, because thou hast done it; And I will hope in thy name, for it is good, in the presence of thy saints.
